title: WCAG 2.2 Supporting Documents
description: The WCAG 2.2 document provides a stable, referenceable technical standard. Supporting documents include:

supporting_docs.title: How to Meet WCAG 2.2
supporting_docs.description: A customizable quick reference to WCAG 2.2 that includes all guidelines, success criteria, and techniques for authors developing and evaluating web content.

supporting_docs.title: Understanding WCAG 2.2
supporting_docs.description: A guide to understanding and implementing WCAG 2.2. This includes short Understanding documents for each guideline and success criterion in WCAG 2.2, as well as key topics.

supporting_docs.title: Techniques for WCAG 2.2
supporting_docs.description: A collection of techniques and common failures, each in a separate document that includes descriptions, examples, code, and tests.

supporting_docs.title: The WCAG 2 Documents
supporting_docs.description: An introductory summary of WCAG 2 supporting documents and supplemental guidance.

supporting_docs.title: What's New in WCAG 2.2
supporting_docs.description: Introduces new success criteria with persona quotes that illustrate accessibility issues.

supporting_docs.title: Design Patterns and Examples
supporting_docs.description: Learn how to make accessible web components and widgets with ARIA roles, states and properties and by implementing keyboard support. One or more ways of implementing each pattern is demonstrated with a functional example.
